task: Copyedit this fictional craft-fair feature paragraph only if it needs a meaningful correction. The supplied reporting record supports the scene and quotation. Preserve the measured descriptive voice and the useful craft term; do not replace observation with promotional praise or invent access to the demonstrator's thoughts.
input: Under a blue awning at Moss Row Fair, a demonstrator worked three strips of brown cloth into a flat braid. When the ends slipped unevenly, she undid the last crossing and began it again. "The braid should lie flat. It needn't look hurried," she said. Visitors watched from low stools, close enough to follow the movement of her hands.

The demonstrator used three strips of brown cloth to make a flat braid.
When the ends slipped unevenly, she undid and repeated the last crossing.

Visitors sat on low stools close enough to see her hand movements.
